value: Final inspection required after all permits are issued and the system is installed, before final approval is granted
Inspections may be scheduled online, by phone, or in person; requests received after 6:00am can be scheduled for the next business day or any business day in the next three weeks

Inspector checks: PV modules match plans/specifications; array conductors and grounding are correctly installed; array is fastened and sealed per attachment detail; required signage (DC disconnect PV power source sign, AC point of connection sign, alternative power system switch sign) is properly constructed and displayed; and equipment ratings (inverter, DC/AC overcurrent protection devices) are consistent with the application and installed signage

value.notes: 'Permit submittals utilizing a standard plan may be approved "over the counter" at our Permit Center by appointment only' (implying same-day approval for eligible standard-plan submittals), and 'Permits not approved "over the counter" should be reviewed in approximately three to five business days.'

value.program_or_pathway: Standard-plan / over-the-counter review at the Permit Center
other_conditions: Planning Division review is not required for rooftop solar PV installations mounted parallel to and less than 12 inches above the roof surface and not extending beyond any ridge or hip
Fire Department approval is not required for solar PV installations

eligibility_constraints.notes: The source document states its scope as 'solar photovoltaic (PV) projects 10 kW in size or smaller' without specifying whether this is an AC or DC nameplate rating, and does not restrict eligibility to a specific property type (single-family, duplex, etc.) the way some other cities' ordinances do — property_types left empty rather than assumed, and the 10kW cap recorded with this ambiguity noted rather than silently treated as equivalent to other cities' explicit '10kW AC' figures.

permit_fees.notes: The Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Projects handout describes the plan review and inspection process but does not state a specific permit fee amount or fee schedule.
